# Livia Zaharia

> Romanian architect, parametric jewellery artist, and citizen scientist.
> Website: https://livia.glucosedao.org
> Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/paral_design/
> GitHub (GlucoseDAO): https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/

## Biography

Livia Zaharia is a Romanian architect and parametric jewellery artist who uses script-driven, generative geometry to create nature-evoking wearable objects and installations. She works under the label **Paral Design** (Parametric Livia), translating computational architectural methods into intimate, research-driven, body-scale artefacts.

Her artistic identity sits at the intersection of three domains: **generative art** rooted in architectural parametric tools, **speculative design for health and longevity**, and **experimental contemporary jewellery** — exhibited at [Romanian Jewelry Week](https://www.romanianjewelryweek.com/participants-2025/livia-zaharia) every year since 2021.

Her tools include **Grasshopper** (visual programming for Rhino), **COMPAS** (computational architecture framework), and **Python** scripts for generative geometry. Digital models are 3D-printed, cast primarily in silver, and sometimes combined with natural materials — walnut husks, amber, quartz — through traditional metalworking.

Beyond her art practice, Livia is the founder of [GlucoseDAO](https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/), a healthtech initiative building open-source tools for glucose prediction and metabolic health, including the [Sugar-Sugar Game](https://sugar-sugar.glucosedao.org) — a browser-based tool where participants predict blood glucose trajectories and compare their accuracy against ML models. GlucoseDAO operates in collaboration with Universitätsmedizin Rostock.

She is a contributor to the [Longevity Genie](https://longevity-genie.github.io) open-source ecosystem, where her [Materialized Enhancements](https://materialized-enhancements.longevity-genie.info/) project bridges physical artefact-making and computational biology. She is affiliated with [HEALES](https://heales.org/) (Healthy Life Extension Society) and has taught AI agentic workshops in bioinformatics.

Outside the studio and the lab, Livia is an avid **swimmer** — her proper stroke is crawl, and she is currently learning butterfly and monofin. She is also a dedicated **hiker**, with Jepii Mici being her favourite Romanian hiking route and the Predeal mountain race her favourite running event. She is obsessed with **gemstones** and with **growing plants** — passions that feed directly back into her nature-inspired parametric work.

Her design work is presented under [@paral_design](https://www.instagram.com/paral_design/) on Instagram, on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/byLiviaZaharia/) as **byLiviaZaharia**, and professionally on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/livia-zaharia-4b1425a0). Together, these two branches — art and science — form one interdisciplinary practice between living systems and computational form.


## Art & Design

### Overview

# Parametric Design Practice

Livia Zaharia is a Romanian architect and parametric jewellery artist working under the label **Paral Design** (Parametric Livia). She translates computational architectural methods into intimate, research-driven, body-scale artefacts — rings, pendants, earrings, and wearable objects that sit at the intersection of generative art, speculative design, and experimental contemporary jewellery.

## Method

The design process uses **parametric and script-driven 3D modelling** — primarily [Grasshopper](https://www.grasshopper3d.com/) for Rhino, the [COMPAS](https://compas.dev/) computational framework, and custom Python scripts. Base geometries are defined and then transformed into multiple variants through controlled changes in equations and parameters.

## Fabrication

The workflow moves from **digital modelling** through **3D printing**, then to **casting** in silver and other metals, and finally **manual assembly** — incorporating hand-assembled mechanisms, traditional metalworking, and mixed-material construction.

## Materials

Silver, brass, copper, quartz, amber, walnut husks, 3D-printed elements, and repurposed found objects recontextualised into new pieces.

## Visual Language

- **Fractal** — self-similar structures at multiple scales
- **Biomimetic** — forms that echo biological morphology without directly copying specific organisms
- **Layered surfaces** — complex stacked or nested geometries
- **Repeated modules** — parametric repetition with controlled variation
- **Complex curvature** — non-planar surfaces inviting tactile exploration

Pieces appear inspired by shells, corals, plants, or cellular structures — yet are generated entirely through code and parametric rules. This raises the question of what counts as "original" versus "copy" when an algorithm produces forms indistinguishable from natural ones.


### Livia Lore

# The Artifacts of Livia

Every piece forged by Livia carries an alternate-universe fantasy layer — an RPG-flavoured narrative where each artefact is an enchanted item with stats, abilities, and hidden connections. At the heart of it all sits **The Nut of Power**, the supreme artifact that binds and commands every other creation.

## Artifact Connection Schema

The Nut of Power sits at the centre of Livia's artifact constellation, exerting dominion over every other creation. Each artifact enhances specific attributes, and together they form an interconnected web of power.

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3493.jpg -->

**The Nut of Power** — +∞ Dominion — *controls all artifacts*

**Controlled artifacts:**

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3481.jpg -->

**The Dark Nut of Power** — +5 Dark Arts, +3 Intimidation — *cursed clone, sealed by Flough*

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3433.jpg -->

**The Nanot of Power** — +5 Nanotechnology, +3 Biotechnology — *catches soluble TNF-alpha*

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3475.jpg -->

**Mitoring** — +4 Energy, +2 Endurance — *powerhouse of the... Livia*

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3465.jpg -->

**Embryo Ring** — +4 Luck, +3 Creativity — *blesses new projects*

**The Eye of Winter** — +5 Frost, +2 Transformation — *area freeze, shape-shifts between pendant and ring*

**Kidney Pendant** — +5 Poison Resistance, +2 Purification — *Borș immunity*

**The Snail Ring** — Stats: ??? — *awaiting discovery*

**Dominion hierarchy:** The Nut of Power controls all artifacts. The Dark Nut is its shadow clone — powerful but unstable, requiring Flough to contain its curse leakage. All other artifacts operate independently but are ultimately subject to the Nut's authority.

**Stat categories:** Nanotechnology, Biotechnology, Dark Arts, Intimidation, Energy, Endurance, Luck, Creativity, Frost, Transformation, Poison Resistance, Purification, Dominion.

## Artifacts

### The Nut of Power

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3493.jpg -->

*"One Nut to rule them all, one Nut to find them, one Nut to bring them all, and in the darkness bind them."*

The most powerful artifact ever forged by Livia. It controls all other artifacts she has made — a supreme conduit of dominion. Half walnut shell, half amethyst sphere, joined by brass bands and a leather strap, it pulses with ancient energy drawn from the earth itself.

**Type:** Pendant | **Materials:** Brass, Walnut, Amethyst | **Size:** 3.4 × 3.4 cm | **Year:** 2024

**Stats:** +∞ Dominion | **Ability:** Absolute control over all other artifacts forged by Livia

### The Dark Nut of Power

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3481.jpg -->

The dark clone of the Nut of Power, forged in shadow. Encased in a blackened walnut husk with copper innards exposed like a wound, this artifact carries a terrible curse — it can curse people that Livia does not like. More dangerously, it sometimes *leaks*, cursing without conscious control.

The leakage is sealed by **Flough** — a seal-type pillow possessed by Anton that functions as a containment device.

**Type:** Pendant | **Materials:** Copper, Walnut | **Size:** 3.4 × 3.4 cm | **Year:** 2024

**Stats:** +5 Dark Arts, +3 Intimidation | **Ability:** Targeted and uncontrolled cursing | **Weakness:** Sealed by Flough

<!-- artifact: /RJW2025/IMG_3485.jpg -->

## Character Card — Livia, the Artifactor

**Name:** Livia | **Class:** Artifactor / Herbalist | **Level:** Legendary

Livia is a dual-class wielder: as an **Artifactor**, she forges enchanted artifacts from metal, stone, and organic matter; as a **Herbalist**, she carries a deep love for plants and draws botanical power from the living world.

**Curse:** Type I Diabetes — a persistent debuff that cannot be removed, only managed through alchemy and technology.

**Parentage:** Daughter of the Dark Lord and the Teleporter.

**Superabilities:**

- **Instant Sleep** — Even several minutes of a statistics course triggers immediate, irresistible sleep. This ability is so powerful that no statistics lecture can overcome it... with one exception: *BlueBrown-level statistics*, which is engaging enough to resist the effect.

- **Artifact Forging** — Can create enchanted items from parametric digital models, 3D printing, and traditional metalworking.

- **Herbal Affinity** — Natural bond with plants; can sense their needs and draw strength from green spaces.

*Further abilities TBD.*

---

## Lore Entities

**Flough** — A seal-type pillow possessed by Anton. Functions as a containment device for the Dark Nut of Power's curse leakage. Without Flough, the Dark Nut's curses would leak uncontrollably into the surrounding world.


### Materialized Enhancements

[Materialized Enhancements](https://materialized-enhancements.longevity-genie.info/) is a platform that translates human biological upgrades into generative, wearable art. Users select desired "enhancement genes" through an intuitive interface built in [Reflex](https://reflex.dev/), and the system generates a unique, 3D-printable artefact shaped by their biological choices.

The gene library draws from extreme survival traits found across life on Earth — shark longevity, tardigrade radiation shields, axolotl regeneration, mantis shrimp optics, and more — each backed by a peer-reviewed research paper. The result is a personal totem: an unrepeatable 3D form that materialises your vision of your own biological future.

The project reframes genetic enhancement not as medical intervention but as creative self-authorship — a materialised declaration of who you want to become, drawing from what 3.8 billion years of evolution has already prototyped across every branch of life.

Presented at [CODAME ART+TECH](https://www.codame.com/p/materialized-enhancements) "The New Human" Creative Hackathon, Milano Design Week (March 2026). Built across 1,500+ kilometres — from Milan to Bucharest to Munich — during the hackathon itself.

Team: Livia Zaharia (Design & Storytelling), Newton Winter (Concept & Biology), Anton Kulaga (Engineering & Data), Markel Kori (Video & Storytelling).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OrdT8JCPTdU

Source code: [GitHub](https://github.com/winternewt/materialized-enchancements)


### A world for everyone (RJW 2026)

# A world for everyone (RJW 2026)

**Status:** Submitted — in evaluation.

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2026):** *A world for everyone.*

There are multiple worlds occurring at any given time in our presence, all we have to do is open the eyes and find them.

Looking through a bubble like a space in the depths of a lake or freezing through the Eye of Winter, each piece has its own universe. What all of them have in common is that they are glimpses into different coexisting worlds.

3D printed and assembled where the design calls for it; cast silver, glass, PLA, and natural materials — each piece is unique either by combination or by stone.

### Death Yes No Maybe (Berlin 2026)

# Death Yes No Maybe (Berlin 2026)

*Death? Yes/No/Maybe* is an art and science festival organized by **A Hidden Variable** in Berlin, **20–25 March 2026**, at **Culterim Space Rossmann**.

The programme explores humanity’s pursuit of longevity, immortality, and the technological transformation of the human body. It serves as a platform to ask whether mortality is a necessary condition or a limitation to be overcome, with **50+ international artists and scientists** involved.

**Focus:** The intersection of contemporary art, biomedical science, experimental biohacking, and philosophy around the postponement of death.

**Format:** Visual art, virtual reality (VR/XR), live performances, and panel discussions with artists and researchers.

**Curators:** Ala Leresteux, Lufo Art, and Li Anna Töppe — connecting scientific research with artistic imagination.

**Themes:** Ethical, social, and spiritual dimensions of life extension, human–machine integration, and what it means to die.


### It's Just a Cell Life (RJW 2025)

# It's Just a Cell Life (RJW 2025)

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2025):** *It's just a cell life — Biology collection.*

It all started with a cell. It grew, divided and specialized. This collection recalls that: different forms record different stages or parts of the cell. The collection has a start point, the Nucleus, and an end point — Embryo. Not only 3D-printed techniques are used: natural materials are integrated via more traditional methods — walnut husks combined with metal, natural amber trapped in digitally designed settings. Nano particles — a new medical technology — appear as silver, with or without inclusions. Each piece has a story.

The line also includes microscope- and molecule-inspired work: rings, pendants, and earrings echoing cells, tissues, nanoparticles, and organelles — including the Nanot-of-Power pendant (nanomedicine-inspired) and the Mitochondria ring.

### Shine bright like a star (Osmium 2025)

# Shine bright like a star (Osmium 2025)

**Year:** 2025

**Status:** Participation only — the collection did not reach the finalist stage.

**Collection idea (Light-space-shape series)**

Light has no shape. However it reveals the shapes hidden in space. As such any shape will be sculpted by the light.

Since osmium can be considered a pure source of light (at least according to the properties of what is reflected from it), obviously any shape will have to accommodate it.

There are technical limitations, however nothing that human creativity cannot overcome. Any 3D surface can be converted into flat shapes that will protect the light. Shape deconstructing is also a part of the light.

This series is meant to be inspired by space and the cosmic objects that usually are the proving ground of numerous light behaviors — stars. *Shine bright like a diamond* needs to be rewritten. The only measure are the stars.

**A pair of earrings — *Sound of stars*** — where all begins. Stars are formed in the ripples of universe expansion. Sound doesn't travel through space, however light does. In the object created we have both rippling of light and sound. They are just tiny bells.

**A pendant — *White dwarf*** — late stages of star life, when all its essence is dense and heavy. Feel the heaviness of light with an imposing shape meant to gather the attention.

**A ring — *Supernova*** — where all the sparkle that has been gathered during its long life will explode. A core that is protected by the strong outward forces.

### Beloved Food (RJW 2024)

# Beloved Food (RJW 2024)

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2024):** *Beloved food*

Sometimes food inspires us — not only in the kitchen while we prepare it, or at the table where we enjoy it, but also in shape and form. Memories and experiences are tied to our taste. Using materials which are most certainly not edible, this collection remembers some very familiar elements. The sweet paste filled *Nocciola*, or the *Bird's nest*, are only some of them. At first people might wonder where the connection is, but we all have to keep in mind: some of humanity's most persistent memories revolve around food. Those treasured memories come back in a way that will last longer than the food itself and reflect what matters most.

### Survival (RJW 2023)

# Survival (RJW 2023)

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2023):** *Survival*

Being lost in a lush jungle where everything is as changing as it is beautiful. Deep colours recall plants which may or may not be dangerous. The only certain thing is that there is beauty of different shapes and sizes which sometimes can morph into function or form. Each item is unique and tells its own tale of survival — an ever-changing deep forest and its hidden paths. All pieces were cast in silver after being modelled in 3D; some mechanisms were manually assembled.

## Exhibition venue

<!-- artifact: /RJW2023/543721001090896.jpg -->

### Paths. Memories. Guides (RJW 2022)

# Paths. Memories. Guides (RJW 2022)

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2022):** *Paths. Memories. Guides*

A path that has been set by an event or record. A model to follow which cannot be changed. Memories which record what lies inside us — whether it is a living being, a sound wave or a building. Guides that actively help us find new paths, and the cycle repeats.

Paths fade to memories; memories in turn become guides. All pieces were made using 3D modelling software, 3D printed and cast into silver or laser cut. What makes the difference is the individual backstory of each.

Includes work such as *Sticks and stones* (silver, epidote, prehnite), *La navette* (silver, synthetic alexandrite), *Piguen* (silver, meteorite), *Sunfinder* (plexiglass, Iceland spar), *King's Chapel* (silver, enhanced tourmaline), *Inline*, and *Amberear*.

### Parametric (by) nature (RJW 2021)

# Parametric (by) nature (RJW 2021)

**Collection concept (Romanian Jewelry Week 2021):** *Parametric (by) nature*

Even though it looks unrestrained, nature has a set of hidden rules. Using those rules, today's computational ability and human inspiration brought these pieces to life. The selection has two parts: **elements** and **entities**. The first is restricted to water for now, in all its forms, based on the characteristics of this element. The second part is mostly related to plants. Each piece was made by 3D modelling and printing and is still unique.

Includes *Ceartari* earrings and rings, *Ice*, *Splash*, and *Fasolaluna (Beanut)* pendants, *Mountain of gold* ring and pendant, and *Mycelium* ring.

## Exhibition venue

### Flute (Concept 2021)

# Flute

Concept proposal exploring how **insulin vials** could be reused and turned into a small **token for people living with diabetes** — a tactile, symbolic object rather than disposable packaging.

The idea was to keep the material memory of daily care while giving it a new narrative: a flute-like form as a quiet, portable emblem.

### Hardata (Timișoara 2021)

# Hardata

**Hardata** was submitted to the **Hyper Form** international **3D-printable sculpture** open call run by **[Lapsus Art Space and Laboratory](https://lapsus607268604.wordpress.com/hyperdome/)** in **Timișoara** (Hyperdome / Hyper Form programme). The work **won first prize**; a later edition invited the author to join the **jury**.

The open-call page describes printing selected works at Lapsus and the prize structure: [Hyper Form — Lapsus](https://lapsus607268604.wordpress.com/hyperdome/).

### Untold Galaxy Stage (Untold 2018)

# Untold Galaxy Stage

**Untold** is a major music festival in **Cluj-Napoca**. In **2018**, work focused on the **material division** for the **Galaxy Stage** — a complex, non-standard geometry that had to read clearly on site and in production drawings.

### iMAPP (iMapp 2017-2018)

# iMAPP — still mapping

**iMapp Bucharest** is a large-scale **projection mapping** festival centred on the **Palace of the Parliament**. Alongside the animated videomapping competition, the festival runs **stillMapp** — a **still-image** (non-animated) mapping strand for single frames mapped onto the façade.

In **2017**, the festival awarded the **stillMapp Award** to **Livia Zaharia** ([official 2017 page](https://imapp.ro/2017-2/): *“Our warmest congratulations go to Livia Zaharia, for submitting one of the best entries in the history of stillMapp…”*).

Participation continued in **still mapping** in **2018**. Edition pages: [iMapp 2017](https://imapp.ro/2017-2/) · [iMapp 2018](https://imapp.ro/2018-2/).

## Science & Tech

### Overview

Livia is a citizen scientist, open-source contributor, and volunteer researcher working at the intersection of computational biology, AI, and digital health.

She is a member of [HEALES](https://heales.org/) (Healthy Life Extension Society), a volunteer at [Universitätsmedizin Rostock (IBIMA)](https://ibima.med.uni-rostock.de/), and an active participant in the longevity research community — including [ARDD](https://www.ardd.info/) conferences and [Berlin Longevity Week](https://www.longevityweek.de/).

Beyond her design practice, Livia works with a scientific and engineering stack including Python, PyTorch, Polars, NeuralForecaster for time-series forecasting, and agentic AI frameworks. She has taught numerous AI agentic workshops in bioinformatics, positioning her not just as an artist who references science, but as a practitioner who actively builds and deploys ML pipelines.

Her work spans founding [GlucoseDAO](https://glucosedao.org/) for open glucose prediction research, contributing to [Longevity Genie](https://longevity-genie.github.io) open-source tools, and creating [Materialized Enhancements](https://materialized-enhancements.longevity-genie.info/) — a platform turning synthetic biology into participatory generative art.


### GlucoseDAO

[GlucoseDAO](https://glucosedao.org/) is a healthtech initiative building open-source tools that help people understand and predict glucose dynamics, with a focus on reducing uncertainty in daily decision-making.

The idea grew from lived type 1 diabetes experience and continuous glucose monitoring observations during the pandemic. The team expanded around a shared mission: combine scientific rigor, machine learning, and usable product design to support both people with diabetes and broader metabolic health use cases.

Key components include the [Sugar-Sugar Game](https://sugar-sugar.glucosedao.org) — a browser-based tool where participants predict blood glucose trajectories from real CGM data — an open-source data standardization pipeline, and transformer-based model benchmarking for glucose prediction.

GlucoseDAO operates in collaboration with Universitätsmedizin Rostock (IBIMA), with ethics clearance for a formal human-vs-AI benchmarking study.

Read the full startup story:
https://rubikhub.ro/startup-story-glucosedao-rubik-garage-healthtech-edition/

Watch the video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6aTajGZCnEA


### Materialized Enhancements

[Materialized Enhancements](https://materialized-enhancements.longevity-genie.info/) is a platform that translates human biological upgrades into generative, wearable art. Users select desired "enhancement genes" through an intuitive interface built in [Reflex](https://reflex.dev/), and the system generates a unique, 3D-printable artefact shaped by their biological choices.

The gene library draws from extreme survival traits found across life on Earth — shark longevity, tardigrade radiation shields, axolotl regeneration, mantis shrimp optics, and more — each backed by a peer-reviewed research paper. The result is a personal totem: an unrepeatable 3D form that materialises your vision of your own biological future.

The project reframes genetic enhancement not as medical intervention but as creative self-authorship — a materialised declaration of who you want to become, drawing from what 3.8 billion years of evolution has already prototyped across every branch of life.

Presented at [CODAME ART+TECH](https://www.codame.com/p/materialized-enhancements) "The New Human" Creative Hackathon, Milano Design Week (March 2026). Built across 1,500+ kilometres — from Milan to Bucharest to Munich — during the hackathon itself.

Team: Livia Zaharia (Design & Storytelling), Newton Winter (Concept & Biology), Anton Kulaga (Engineering & Data), Markel Kori (Video & Storytelling).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OrdT8JCPTdU

Source code: [GitHub](https://github.com/winternewt/materialized-enchancements)


### Longevity Genie

Livia is a contributor and citizen scientist within the [Longevity Genie](https://longevity-genie.github.io) open-source ecosystem — an organisation building AI-driven tools for longevity biology.

Key projects include gene-expression analysis pipelines, bioinformatics agent frameworks, and open datasets for aging research. The ecosystem connects researchers, developers, and citizen scientists around a shared mission of understanding and extending healthy lifespan.

Livia's contributions bridge physical artefact-making and computational biology infrastructure — from designing science-inspired wearable objects to building and deploying ML pipelines for biological data.

GitHub: [github.com/longevity-genie](https://github.com/longevity-genie)

## Amberear Ring

Ring cast in silver and natural stone amber with an insect in it. Part of Listen to your heart series together with Sticks and stones.
I will not retell the story of the series but I will rather focus on this piece. The elements that surround the stone are ears - trying to listen to a message from the past.
Technically speaking the shape helps to protect the mounted stone as not to collide with various surface while in wear.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

## Art Nouveau Earings

This pair is the first to try out the most comfortable mode of earrings fixing. It is also embedded in the shape of the object that is spreading out in wire thin lines. Cast in silver.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2018.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Art-Nouveau earings -->

## Art Nouveau Ring

Cast in silver with an amethist cabouchon. The first complete flush setting. Considering the shape something lightweight and lithe- easy to wear- was needed. The art nouveau inspiration seemed apropriate to an oval shape. Can be worn as a set with the Pretzel earrings.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Art-Nouveau ring -->

## Beanut (fasolaluna) Pendant

Pendant cast in silver with epidote and perhenit. Its story begins with the stone which I found first and understood that I will have to make a setting for it. What came out got its name from the shape of the stone (bean) and that of the setting (nut).

## Blooming Pins

Series of 6 pins cast in silver. The idea came from the flowers which at that point in time, were beginning to bloom and how the slowly unfold. I made 2 subcategories, with large potential for expansion, flower design being a vast subject. The peony series and Spiral series. Peony has 4 instances whilst Spiral only two. Their small dimensions enable them to be used as an accessory in almost any event going from casual to more pretentious ones. At the moment the dimensions are 12 and 9 mm diameter but can be adapted in number of petals and size, that being the reason why I consider them to be one of the most versatile creations.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Blooming pins -->

## Blooming Ring

Photographs from the studio archive.

<!-- gallery: pieces/Blooming ring -->

## Bracelet Extension

Here is all about solving a technical dilemma. I had a rigid bronze bracelet too big for my hand, the hole in which the hand came in being simply to large( however the general diameter of the bracelet being ok). To solve this problem I developed this system of extensions with ornamental endings that can be removed to be able to reduce the opening and to change the model anytime I wanted. Cast in bronze.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2018.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Bracelet-extension -->

## Cabochon Ring

One of the most complex pieces because of the stone fixture method. In fact its geometry was so complex that I was able to understand it after I molded it. Its beauty lies in the fact that it is adaptive. The central piece is a fixed sized cabochon but it might as well hold anything printed using as a base the cabochon shape but spreading out from the setting. The set piece can be then changed by the users themselves. That is because the ring opens by gently pressing it. Cast in silver.

-modificari de dimensiuni (circumferinta, latime, grosime) -modificari de model (schimbarea unor elemente de design gen pozitie sau numar de elemente, modificari de model de suprafata)

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Cabochon ring -->

## Ceartari Earings

## First Ring

The first cast piece. The model is made of polygons with variable heights. The front opening allows it to be adjusted for any finger of the user's hand. The metal chosen to cast from was silver, but a bronze one was also made to take part in an exhibition.

A bit of inside story. Cam mult de lecturat Ã®nsÄ. Cum se procedeaza? Exista vreo limitare? Puncte cheie deci care trebuie retinute: The works on the page are for sale? Yes- with the mention that all accessories are custom made. On the page the prototypes are featured, made by my measures to be able to test first hand how they behave in daily use. How does it work? Is there any restrictions? Restrictions-related…

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2022.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/First ring -->

## Fistic Ring

Cast in silver ring with a bullet shaped synthetic peridote. Slightly adaptable. The concept started from the shape and colour of the stone — the green tone recalled pistachio (*pistacchio*); 

The ring’s geometry keeps the stone loose so, if you have the same shape, you can replace it. Regarding synthetic stones, they are made in a lab: a natural quartz base is baked in a kiln with minerals (such as iron for the green) to reach the desired colour.

<!-- gallery: pieces/Fistic ring -->

## Florine Ring

First square ring. The shape was inspired by the set stone, octahedral fluorite cristal. Basically, in nature, crystals like these are formed in soft soils which allow individual growth from the particular component elements. Cast in silver, the stone is a naturally shaped fluorite

<!-- gallery: pieces/Florine ring -->

## Ice Pendant

Rock cristal set in silver cast pendant.
The ideea here was simple- the stone is transparent, cold, it is a cristal so it would need a ploygonal shape like a cocoon to protect its tip. Ice is the element it can be associated to. Although it needs protection the purpose of a jewelery is not only to cover the stone but also to show it off.
A chalange in this case I would like to mention the irregular shape of the piece to set. It is infinitely more difficult to come up with a setting for a irregular geometry.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

## La Navette Pendant

Cast in silver pendant with free rotation in two directions with synthetic alexandrite.
Its story begins with the stone and I've told it before. What we see in the setting is Alexandrite, a stone that originally came from Russia well known for pleochroism(it changes color depending on the light). My stone swaps between warm purple (warm light) to pale blue of a sapphire (cold light or neon). For more details see the link below.
Its cut, in a flattened ellipse- called navette or marquise-is what inspired the shape. The story says the name marquise comes from a king of France who requested a stone cut to resemble the lips of his mistress- a marquise. And navette comes from how it looks similar to a boat.
That is why I wanted it to move- like a boat on water, with changing colors, or a compass.

https://www.gia.edu/alexandrite

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

### Romanian Jewelry Week 2022 — *Paths. Memories. Guides*

**Type:** Pendant | **Materials:** Silver, synthetic alexandrite | **Dimensions:** 4.5 × 3.5 × 1.2 cm | **Year:** 2021

<!-- artifact: /RJW2022/navette-circle.jpg -->

<!-- artifact: /RJW2022/LiviaZaharia-pendant-La navette-1-2021_silver_syntheticalexandrite_4.5x3.5x1.2cm.jpg -->

<!-- artifact: /RJW2022/LiviaZaharia-pendant-La navette-2-2021_silver_syntheticalexandrite_4.5x3.5x1.2cm.jpg -->

## Merlusca (denisa) Ring

Cast in silver ring with grown pearl. It was made on order and based on the prototype bearing the same name. Let me draw to your attention the adjustments made, because each piece made after a model is altered both because of the dimensions and of the stone. This is why in the pictures it is shown in comparison.
For this piece I altered just the stone setting and the width of the ring. Elsewise everything is made to resemble the prototype.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Merlusca (Denisa) ring -->

## Merlusca Ring

First mounting- in the beginning I wanted a perfectly round pearl, like the one in the renderings. Chance was that a tear shaped pearl fit the spot better. The piece is a flexible one, firstly because of the thickness but also because of the hole number, having more in the back to allow the pearl to mounted in front. It is the most delicate though ring I've ever made. The nickname comes from pearl+mollusc. 
Cast in silver, with a culture pearl.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2018.*

## Mountain of Gold Double Ring

A two-finger ring which can be worn as a pendant, cast in silver with citrine. The model started, of course, from the stone. I've found it in a souvenir shop and I liked its shape and colour, however I could not see how to mount it. After some long periods of thought and some adventures in the process of casting I finally got a two-finger ring that can be worn as a pendant. Its name comes from the model of a mountain covered by water- an image that got stuck in my mind as I've seen it glowing golden in the sun.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

## Mr Bean Masca Pendant

Custom order. It is a pendant cast in silver and was literally the biggest object ever made till now. On the long axis, it is about 7 cm and aprox 120 g after polishing. The image was given by the client but the 3d modeling was made by a script. I've got lots to learn from this project and at the end the owner (for whom it was a surprise gift) was satisfied. It should be mentioned that it is at the upper limit of castable size and weight. At the moment.

<!-- gallery: pieces/Mr-bean-masca pendant -->

## Mushroom Ring

It is a symbiosis between polygons and nature. Or that's how I see it. Each mushroom is the hat resulting from the joining of each polygons' center that are closest to a point. Or you could just admire the resulting shape. Cast in silver.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2018 and 2018.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Mushroom ring -->

## Mycelium Ring

Cast in silver ring with opal. It has a nice backstory. At first I had a structural problem- opal is microscopic porous stone and it can retain more or less water because of this. Water and temperature variations may cause over time cracks to appear. Thus I was in need of a system to allow water to flow away if it got there. So I had some help from the mushrooms and fungi- hence the name- to create the water drainage from the stone.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TFjyhCmkPyM

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

### Romanian Jewelry Week 2021 — *Parametric (by) nature*

**Type:** Ring | **Materials:** Sterling silver, opal | **Dimensions:** 2.1 × 2.0 × 2.8 cm | **Year:** 2021

## Peas in Pod Ring

Cast in silver ring with moving jade beads inside. The concept started out from gears. The one from your car, or bike, which is in continuous motion. And from some beads(which meanwhile increased in number) of jade which I had lying around.
The ring had to be one the wouldn't hook on clothes, could be worn under latex gloves, to include the green beads and to be able to move. So the end result was this.

## Pretzel Earings

Cast in silver, each piece has 2 set amethyst cabochons. The model is a variation of the flexible system in the previous earrings. Now it is fixed and not centered. The Pretzel part of the name comes from the initial sketch which can still be seen in the side view. They can be worn as a set with the amethyst art nouveau ring

<!-- gallery: pieces/Pretzel earings -->

## Red Wormy Little Apple Ring

Ring cas in silver with dyed shell bead in the setting. It is adapted from Wormy, but because of the striking colour of the stone decided to call it Little apple.
This time I rodhium platted the bas, which will ensure a longer metal shine in time and it will be hypoalergenic (there are some types of skins the oxidize silver faster).
the geometry of the piece has a surprising stiffness.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Red-wormy-little-apple ring -->

## Roots Ring

Started from the same base as Mushroom ring, Roots shows the difference that can be made from the algorithm. It is a slender ring cast in silver and adjustable. To be mentioned that for future castings I will geometrically reinforce it.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2019 and 2019.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Roots ring -->

## Rotary Magnetic Ring

Work in progress (or in alteration)
Cast silver ring with blue-green tourmaline (sometimes called Indicolite) with moving parts.
As usual I started from the stone. And from my general curiozity plus the apparent lack of normal gliding systems in jewelery.
The stone is a tourmaline that changes colour in accordance with light position- it can be of a dark, ink like blue or a darker shade of green as seen in the pictures. Since I decided I must take advantage of this feature I tried to find a rotary sistem which, as can be seen from the pictures and short animation, works.
It is, however,a work in progress because I noticed a detail of the fitting I want to imporve...I will upload photos when the time comes- for those that want to guess what it is, they are free to do so :)

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2021.*

### Romanian Jewelry Week 2026 — *A world for everyone*

## Soft Art Nouveau Railing Ring

Cast in silver ring with synthetic ametrine. Ametrine is a citrine that was exposed to high temperatures and became an amethyst. (see link below)
when I first saw these colors the thought was art nouveau, and after remarking upon its straight lines I searched for the balance in the curves of the style. Inspired by the architectural language it brought back to my mind the railings of art nouveau staircases, so fluid when touched, without any sudden interruptions, going smoothly around a straight, geometric and calculated stair. And that was it.

https://www.gia.edu/ametrine

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Soft-Art-Nouveau-railing ring -->

## Splash Pendant

Pendant. Cast in silver it holds a stone of quartz (rock crystal) inside. It was registered for a competion but the jury's deccision was that it was not suited to the theme. Anyway, it still remains one of my favorite. The curves on the outside suggest the ripples in the water and are generated by a geometric script, thus being customizable.

## Sticks and Stones Pendant

Cast in silver pendant with natural pherenite and epidote. Masive-it has around 50g out which 13.9 are the stone. Part of the series with Amberear. Series named somewhat sentimentally Listen to your heart. First we will go into the concept story and then for the technical part.
As usual I started from the stone, spherical, centered, closed in itself. Just like a nucleus. Although I clearly saw it as a pendant I was not yet sure of the shape it would have. Later on I found the second stone- the amber from the ring. That stone has an insect- just like a memory form a long time ago. Like a memory of the past. Like a thought we are straining to hear. So if in the first case we had the heart- hence the thorax- in the second case it was like a nucleus of memory which should be listened to- hence the ears.
And while searching for a name for the new creation I just remembered the idiom of Sticks and stones may break my bones but words will never hurt me. Putting aside it is really made out of sticks and stones, the meaning of that phrase fits like a glove.that is why the complete name would actually be Sticks and stones (may make my bones)
As for the technical part- the stone has an axial mounting system with two threaded parts so that the weight of the whole object is fully supported.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

### Romanian Jewelry Week 2022 — *Paths. Memories. Guides*

**Type:** Pendant | **Materials:** Silver, epidote, prehnite | **Dimensions:** 6.5 × 4.6 × 3.5 cm | **Year:** 2021

## War and Peace Ring

Silver cast model with labradorite stone. The largest ring I designed- it covers 3 fingers. As it often happens in the case of stones the design came from the gems and how they can come off in a special shape. The name comes from people's reaction when they've seen it- everyone said that it is covered in peace signs but their thoughts were further from that idea and less peaceful.... The opening in the actual cast object allows for a tighter diameter and thus a better grip for it's large size.

<!-- gallery: pieces/War-and-peace ring -->

Photographs from the studio archive.

## Weddiing Rings

Custom made. Two of my friends decided to tie the knot in a special way so they wanted a pair of wedding rings with some design peculiarities. That is how, after a period of discussions on various issues we managed to get the perfect design they were looking for. And the two rings have now a loving home. Cast in yellow gold (14kt) and trials made in bronze.

<!-- gallery: pieces/Weddiing-rings -->

## Wormy Ring

Ring cast in silver with a purple culture pearl. Initially, I tried fixing the pearl, with an intresting shape and color in a way that would maximize its effect. And this is how it came to be. Still, I found out on this occasion how the woven pattern can reinforce the shape. Even though it is an open ring its geometry gives it more resistance.
The unusual shape encouraged some to describe it as a mini creature from Dune.

<!-- gallery: pieces/Wormy ring -->

## Woven Wedding Rings

@Cristian Avram
@Teodora Mihaela

Pair of 14kt gold wedding rings. The concept was woven. How  fine and precise can you cast a woven like pattern. The end result is seen here :)
As for the name (a.n. Ro: Brancovenesc) it is because of the similar decoration from this style.
In the pictures we can see the 3D model, the silver prototype and the final gold cast to spot the differences of gold vs silver casting.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2020 and 2020.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Woven wedding rings -->

## Yellow Submarine Pendant

Cast in silver pendant, with yellow jade beads. Besides the Beatles reference, the submarine remembers a worker on a real sub regarding how to cope with isolation. His advice was somewhere along the lines-take care of what you can solve. There is no point in fretting over things you can't control and can't do a thing about them.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2021 and 2021.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/Yellow-submarine pendant -->

## Cheesecacke Pendant

The model was thought out so that the wearer has the choice of how it is worn- with a single point of contact between the pendant and necklace or "sewn" along the perforated edge.Thus it would be a pendant or included in a choker. The concept was applied to leather band or textile strand. It was cast in silver, but could work out very well in bronze also, since it has quite ample size and volume.

*Mentioned on Facebook between 2022 and 2022.*

<!-- gallery: pieces/cheesecacke pendant -->

## Untold Galaxy Stage 2017

UNTOLD GALAXY STAGE 2017
client: Mindscape Studio

https://www.mindscapestudio.ro/event-design/untold-galaxy-stage-2017-making-of/

Here I helped with the surface division of the stage. Each strip of textile was extracted from the 3d model and then numbered for an easier in situ assembly. The vertical ellipse is 16m x6.5m

<!-- gallery: pieces/large-scale-parametrics- Untold Galaxy stage 2017 -->

## Untold Galaxy Stage 2018

UNTOLD GALAXY STAGE 2018
client: Mindscape Studio

Here starting from the same idea of the two ellipses we increased the complexity. The vertical ellipse went up to 24m x 8m but the double layer of the wrapping allowed for the light settings to be rearranged
